comment_clean: Michael is a really nice and caring host, the apartment is in great condition and provided with everything you need for your stay in Porto. Highly recommend.

It was great! Just a brisk walk to the centre (15 mins) alongside the river, which, we quite liked. It was very cool inside despite the hot temperatures outside. The couch slept just fine and we didn’t mind making the bed ourselves. The only downside was that there were little utensils. For example, there were some pots and cutleries but no towels to dry the dishes with nor a rack to put them in. Also, the shower drain was a bit slow so the water would sometimes spill into the rest of the bathroom. However, overall I would recommend this place if you want to stay in Porto for a few days. Thank you!
Awesome stay in heart of Porto, loved it. Had morning coffee with a view, and two colleagues asked why I'm calling from such a nice place
The place is fantastic. Looks even better than the pictures. Co-host Ana is being very responsive and friendly. It was a pleasant stay.

Fantastic apartment! From the moment we arrived, we felt right at home. The apartment was fully equipped with everything we needed. The location is ideal, just steps away from great restaurants, bars, and nightlife. The balcony overlooks a lively terrace, where music plays in the evenings, which we didn’t mind at all. Overall, we couldn’t be happier with our stay. Highly recommended!
Great location. Close to the river and some tucked away restaurants. The only thing we were lacking was WiFi so my son could do his online schooling.
Thank you Pedro & Ana! Our stay was wonderful! Thanks for your hospitality and the recommendations of the 222 road for the nice scenery! And the good restaurant! Thank you so much!!!
Nice location. Loft is well equipped for small family. The loft is facing the street so could be a bit noisy.

We loved our stay here! You are walking distance to great spots to eat and hang out. We were there in the winter so the space heater upstairs was great. The apartment is a duplex. Please note the bedroom is up the stairs and the bathroom is down the stairs. The living space is very stylish and modern. The apartment is very clean. Also note that the apartment is on the first floor near the front door.

Beautiful place, clean, exactly as described, and centrally located to all the popular spots yet was still quiet at night. Daniel was also very responsive and offered a very helpful guide of Porto. Highly recommend!
Nice place, very clean and nicely located, we were 5-10 minutes away from a few touristic places. The host also let us check in earlier, which was great!
Had to find a last minute place to stay and couldn’t have been more lucky to find such a lovely place! Great location and breath taking views, wish I could have stayed longer
There was a power outage and there was no smooth check-in.The room as a whole was not bad, but because it was a terrace and there were too many bugs, the landlord didn't clean the terrace well.
the place is very well located and has a beautiful garden. it has basic things but some other essesntial things that are usually expected at an airbnb, toilet paper, shampoos and coffee ect. .

Great little apartment for exploring Porto - the neighbourhood is convenient for travel to/from Lisbon and the airport and there are lots of great places to eat and drink nearby - we enjoyed Idiota and Aduela Bar. The apartment is really cosy and well decorated and the balcony is great - really enjoyed it. Thanks.

A very unique and special place. The land is beautiful, the old house built in 1780s is amazing and the location was a great get-away. It would be nice to have a map of the property, as there are some nice areas to explore with unique birds, swans, ponds, fruit trees, flowers, etc. recommendation: bring lots of mosquito repellent!!!! Antonio & Luis were great hosts and very kind of them to share this beautiful place.

The place was clean and in a good condition. Very fast response for help and a nice Team. I really recommend this place. The bed ist big and comfortable, the view is nice at night because the music hall is literally in front of the building on this side and you can reach a lot of places by walking.

A warm and friendly welcome by Joao who was very helpful and communicative. The house is in pristine condition, very clean, spacious and comfortable with lovely peaceful surroundings. Unfortunately we only stayed one night so did not have enough time to enjoy the beautiful outdoor area and swimming pool. We would love to return in the summer next year and would highly recommend Joao's place.
We loved our stay here, Augusto is an incredible host and the place was immaculate! It's in a fantastic location, we would definitely come back
The flat was very good for the price. It was clean and nice to stay. Its a basic one But the right flat for a stay where mostly only for sleep.

The place is a bit smaller than it looked on the photos, we were three girls and it was quite difficult to arrange all our stuff. The location is perfect and the host answered really fast to all of our questions:)
Perfect house, clean and very well furnished ! Perfect host as well, Rui answers really fast had a perfect hospitality and helped us a lot to feel comfortable ! »

The location was spectacular. The views of the river alone were mesmerizing. The house itself is on a very quiet cul de sac that sits on the top of a little Jill. There is a terrace with greenery and a small cafe table where you can have your coffee or an evening drink. The interior decorations made us feel surrounded very stylishly. Both bedrooms have great views. We took the tram that is just down the street and within minutes we were in the city center or in nearby Foz. We interacted with both Jose and Luis. Perfectly charming, helpful, and very responsive communicating with them. Oh, the highlight was they recommended we take a small ferry that crosses the river in less than five minutes to the small fishing village. The small restaurant had a grill on the street and made the best sardines and squid. We were sad to leave and would recommend there home.

Henrique always responded very quickly to my emails and answered everything I asked in a friendly manner. His family explained how things worked. Overall, we had great communication and the place was exactly as described and close to a metro station, not far from downtown sao bento. I would definitely stay there again.

We really liked this place. Hugo was a great host, we lost the main door key and he showed up just 10min after we called him and he was super polite and helpful. I highly recommend this place. Thank you Hugo for your help

We recently stayed in Porto at this apartment. It's in an excellent location and we loved the place. It's very clean, modern, and well maintained. José is also an excellent host. He pointed us in the right direction for things to do and great restaurants. José was easy to communicate with and always replied quickly with any questions we had. In fact, we informed him of two small issues. A burnt out lightbulb and the shower was draining slowly. We just wanted to let him know so he could look at it before the next guest arrived. He apologized and immediately came over and took care of both issues. If we ever return to Porto we will definitely stay at this apartment again.

Teresa’s apartment space is simple and pleasant. The no-frills apartment does just the trick when you need a place to stay that is in the city and close to great transportation! Teresa greeted us at the building in a timely manner, showed us the place, and gave us great local tips. I recommend this place for anyone needing a nice landing pad in Porto. Thanks again, Teresa!

Carlos was a great host and a tremendous help to us. We appreciate all he did. Carlos is the host with the most charming and fun personality, as well as being highly articulate! Carlos has made two friends for life! If you truly want the feel and personality of Portugal, this quaint little area offers you the best; small cobblestone streets, charming little shops, with access to larger malls that gives you the best shopping and a short tram ride to downtown Porto and the best restaurants in this area. Lots of beautiful and friendly people are waiting to meet you. The apartment has everything you need whether you are staying two nights or a few months. Enjoy your stay in beautiful Porto, Portugal - we did!

It’s was the best stay we had in Portugal - good location close to all attractions, the apartment had very thoughtful touches that makes you feel right at home. The host was very friendly and helpful. I strongly recommend.

A very nice and cozy place for a family. There is a patio for kids to play. TV sets in every room. Very beautiful church and river nearby. Pretty convenient for public transportation, but using taxis is much better and not very expensive.

I can not say enough about how wonderful this Airbnb apartment is! Look no further, this has everything you would want or think of! It is the perfect location to shops, restaurants, grocery store, transportation, tourist attractions and more! Sofia gave us very clear instructions and her place was very easy to find. The photos don’t do it justice, it is HUGE! We loved having the washer and dryer, the coffee in the morning (she left a few for us to use), the fans (it does get hot but expected in August), extra towels, and ice in the freezer! Highly recommend staying here. Also, we sleep with sound machines and always have, so we didn’t hear anything outside and slept very peacefully.
Beautiful place, perfectly located. Patio is comfortable and has a million dollar view of the famous bridge and the Douro River. Far exceeded my expectations.
This listing is as advertised! It’s very clean and close to sites in Porto. When we return to Porto next spring this will be our preferred choice for an accommodation. I highly recommend!
My family and I had a great stay in Rui’s beautiful apartment. The views were incredible and it is very well located. Highly recommended!

Excellent location, we were made to feel welcome by Susanna, the apartment was clean and tidy. The flat is in the heart of the city with fantastic views of surrounding area, easy access to transport links and local shops. Myself and family would certainly come back here.

the curtains were all very dusty, the kitchen was not very clean and most pans are not compatible with the portable induction stove, the bathroom is serviceable but the shower is a bit of a nightmare on the account of it having a curtain instead of a normal glass door. the house overall is nice and well situated, bedrooms were clean.

Our stay at Dahome apartment was excellent! Flat is located in the city centre (3 min walk to Sao Bento train station and to the Liberdade Square). the host was very helpful and responded to our messages very quickly.

A very large apartment with great decor. Check in was easy as someone greeted us and showed us into the apartment. A supermarket is literally 1min walk and a few others only 10-15min walk away. Trams are down the hill (which can be more expensive than other transport) or local buses nearby (which aren’t very reliable). We used the electric scooters to get around as some of the more busier beach areas with lots of restaurants/shopping were not within walking distance. The host rectified a wifi problem and communication was easy. The apartment was very spacious with 3 bedrooms and great for a family.
Away from the busy noisy streets and a short 12 min walk to the center. A very nice renovated old building with a unique charm.

Our time in Porto was fantastic! We enjoyed our stay at Maria's apartment. Her gracious personality and welcoming demeanor made our stay all that more enjoyable. If you are going to Porto, I would definitely recommend this apartment in the best location of town!

José's appartment is very big, very clean and just beautiful with a huge living room, a nice balcony and a well-equipped kitchen. The check-in was easy - I arrived late in the evening, which was no problem at all. And Jose was a great host, very friendly, polite and helpful. I can definitely recommend this appartment - it's not that central but you only have to walk 5-7 minutes to the next metro station and then it takes another 10 minutes to drive to the centre of Porto. So - if you're looking for a relaxing place with a lot of space, go for it!

The apartment and our stay was amazing. I’ve never experienced that well equipped airbnb place, high quality and thoughtful. Everything was perfectly clean. The host was very kind and helpful. Just a perfect stay. We felt like home. Thank you!
I had a lovely stay in this plage in the heart of the Arts Quarter! The place was bright and clean and had everything you could need.
Great location but if you are in the centre of Porto you need to be aware it will be noisy. We had a fabulous time. A lovely city to visit and enjoy yourself.
We had a great stay here (4 friends). Location was perfect. all the other reviews I read before booking are fair. We especially liked the communal space.

Nice comfortable apartment! Very bright, large windows and good location. We were three families and we are comfortably accommodated in the apartment. Jose met us personally. He told and showed everything in the appartment. Also showed all the attractions on the map. Thanks!!!

Great location in Porto, near the commercial centre (shopping streets) and a short walk to the Port. The room and apartment was as described. Best check in experience to date with a Airbnb host, lots of information and tips on restaurants etc. Best bit was the roof terrace in the apartment, great for chilling out after a good day's walking seeing the sites. Great location/place for lone travellers. Thanks again xxxx

We had a brilliant time staying in Porto and were lucky to have Fred as our host who was brilliant in welcoming us and giving recommendations about what to do while we were staying. Would definitely recommend anyone to visit and stay here!
This is a first-class house. Though small, it is well-equipped, spotlessly clean and in an interesting location with good access to the metro and local shops (10 minutes walk). Highly recommended.
Perfect. Everything was great. Really nice flat, nice atmosphere. A bit noisy in the morning but Porto has to be seen anyway so not a problem at all! Very good location as well.
If you like a quiet, secluded stone house, in nature with wonderful gardening, amazing location by the stream…. This is the place for you.
Spacious apartment, close to everything. João was very responsive. Beds a little hard, but you get used to it.
The house is exactly what is expected in the pictures and the amenities are amazing - the pool, the greenhouse and its vegetables, fresh eggs and the proximity to the river and water sports.
The place is really well located, with a great view! Marcelo and Ana were very attentive.

Our new go-to-place in Porto. wonderful Appartment with a big terrace where you have a surprisingly view in a green area while beeing close to the Porto city center. The Appatment was super clean, in very good shape and communication was super friendly, quick and helpful. We can strongly recommend this place and will come back next time travelling to Porto

The tiny house of Miguel is great. It is located in a beautiful garden close to the city center (20 min walk). Miguel is a super host and makes you feel very welcome. We enjoyed our stay and In would definitly recommand!
We loved the location which was between the tourist sights and the river on one side as well as restaurants and a nice neighborhood on the other side. Place was very clean.

Mario' s apartments was a really great choice for our stay in Porto. The house is located in a very nice and convenient region. It's really close to public transportation and central roads. The apartment provides everything it promises. It is neat, bright and cosy.
It is quite noisy, the sunsets are gorgeous but the view is not of a park- but tenements.

The Stay at Trebid'Ouro exceeded our expectations! First of all, we were very warmly welcome from the very begining by the staff in charge. Then we had lots of small attentions, like fresh fruits and vegetables directly from the tenants' garden. The location is big enough and lies in a very quiet place, away from any other house. Staying with a whole group was fantastic, as everyone had their own room and bathroom. The rest area stays away from the common rooms, so that some of us could rest in peace, while others had fun together. The swimming-pool is THE attraction of the location. Connection to Porto is very easy and shorter tahn expected (40 minutes to Porto center by motorway). Grocery stores available in area (Vale Cabra 10 minutes). Very nice view on the ocean and the Aveiro area. We would come back more often, if we did not live so far away!

Great location, very comfortable and lovely vibe. We had an issue with the door getting stuck but Paolo was very responsive and replied right away. Overall great communication from the hosts and definitely a good place to stay in Porto.
The apartment was very clean, in a central position, with high quality features. Regina always answered to any questions and the check-in/out was very easy. Highly recommend!

I really enjoyed my time there! The apartment was very nice and super comfortable and cozy. It had everything I could possibly need. They asked me everyday if I wanted my room/apartment clean. Every time I told them yes, they left the room completely spotless to the same level I got when I first arrived on my very first day. I was very impressed with the level of commitment they have with making the guest experience pleasant and easy. I have no problem recommending this place and I will definitely keep it in mind for my next visit to Porto.

We had an amazing stay at Andre’s place in Porto. He was so kind and communicative, and even let us drop our bags a little early. The location is perfect right near the train station and very quiet at night. We would definitely stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay in this beautiful house where everything worked perfectly. The place was spotlessly clean, with a lovely, cozy garden and a great grill area. The location was ideal, and the host was incredibly kind and helpful. Highly recommended!
This is a beautiful studio, with breathtaking view to wake up to each morning. Clean and comfortable, great location.
Great place, well located, great for kids to stay as well and really lovely balcony. Stayed for leisure but was also able to get some work done in the little office balcony!

Very cosy flat right in the middle of the town. It's sparky clean and has everything you need. The bed is very comfortable. We were really pleased with the fast check in and all the recommendations we received from the hosts. Fantastic experience! Hope to be back again. Thank you.

Probably the best place you can find for such a good price and its outstanding quality. Much more than we expected! The location is simply 5-10 minutes walk from everything, the area is safe and very beautiful. On the bridge next to the apartment you can watch spectacular sunsets (tip). The manager of the property is very professional and flexible for the best experience of her guests. If we go to Porto any time soon, I will with no doubt contact her to stay there again.

Really loved the apartment. Big in size and went with two small kids. Joana provided cot bed and high chair for the kids. The apartment has got everything you can think of and it’s close to the beach , restaurants, supermarkets and nice shops. You can reach the centre of Porto by bus. Really enjoyed our stay there. Thank you Joana !

Great location, clean studio flat, very helpful & reliable host. Would highly recommend for a solo traveller. Kitchen equipped but without kettle or toaster or oven. There’s a microwave and double burner stove. To make a cup of tea, you have to heat the water in the microwave which I soon got used to doing. There’s also a coffee machine and a tv. Tourist attractions within walking distance as well as the metro which has a direct train to the airport. Would highly recommend this flat

We had an excellent stay to Casa Golgota . Everything was perfect to make and enjoy our wonderful trip in Porto . The Appartement is new , quiet , absolutely comfortable and well decorated so charming place we recommend it without hesitation . Marcos gave us a warm welcoming , and suggest to us the best place in Porto . Thanks for all Marcos .
all great, except one guy came without notice to fix the thermostat. No notice AT ALL, just went into de apartment when mi girlfriend was alone in there and he didn't even speak English. scary
Wonderful appartment very well located , beach restaurant et market within few minutes walk. José was a wonderful host and reply to our mail very quickly. For sure we recommand this place.

Ana’s place is wonderful! Exactly as pictured:) It is in a great location. Just far enough from city center to be quiet at night but close enough to walk most everywhere. I have already reserved the place again for a future visit!

Our stay was excellent! The apartment was very comfortable, clean, and quiet. The location was perfect, a quiet neighborhood about a 20-minute walk from the city center. The Feeling Inn team was always attentive, friendly, and willing to resolve any questions or issues. If we return, we will definitely contact them again. Thank you so much for everything!

Great place and great host! Henrique has an absolutely wonderful Airbnb. Extremely comfortable, spacious, and clean. Another noteworthy thing is Henrique himself is an amazing host. He was there to welcome us, patiently showed us around the apartment and then spent time with us to tell us all about the local recommendations. I would just stay at this same place when I visit Porto again :-)

We loved our stay in Porto and a big part of it is because we had Albino as our host. He picked us up and gave us a little tour and he gave very good recommendations in restos. He was so friendly, despite our language barrier, he felt like family :). Accommodation was great, too. clean and quiet, but when you get outside you are in the main shopping street. Thank you Albino and Cristina for letting us stay in your apartment.
Really nice place! Clean and beautiful! Small but well organized and easy to use! Parking inside gates so your car is safe.
Miguel was very friendly, responsive and willing to help. He even allowed me to check-in early and made sure everything was going smooth for me.
The place was perfect for our group of 7 people. It had everything g we needed. Very clean, team was always helpful and available for all sort of questions . Perfect situated . Thank you !

We enjoyed our stay very much. The beds were comfortable. The apartment was Spick and Spa made a lovely view and outside space. We had all the amenities we needed coffee, iron toaster, tea, kettle dishes, clean linens it was very comfortable and the location couldn’t be better.
Excellent location - lots nearby and easy to walk anywhere in Porto. Host was very responsive and helpful, especially with restaurant recommendations.
loved the place it was lovely and cosy everything was great, a very good communication I really recommend it.

We had a great time in the Rita's House. It is very nicely renovated and tastefully equipped and located in a quiet street only a few blocks from the beach front. Rita's dad who checked us in was very freindly and helpful and gave us many good tips on how to discover the area (e.g. by bike). If we'll ever come back to the Foz area of Porto, we'll make sure to rent one of Rita's tiny & stylish houses!

Marcia's place corresponds to the indications given. It is in an excellent position, easy to reach and close to the station, buses and the metro. The accommodation is very clean and welcoming. Marcià is present thanks to his excellent availability in communicating. In the vicinity of the accommodation you can find everything you need: restaurants, bars, shops and the historic center is easily accessible on foot. For us it was a good base for our vacation. If we were to return to Porto we would like to return to Marcia.

We had a great time at Dayanador's apartment. It is in a fantastic location, literally opposite the metro station directly from the airport, within a few minutes' walk to Porto centre, has a lift, is well equipped (enough crockery to actually cook, a rare find!) and very clean. Very much recommended!
We really liked our stay! Nice place nice view! Clean and easy little appartment! Everything you need for a short stay in porto!

Studio was great, excellent location for ease of walking into town and to the river, also near metro. Staff were helpful and friendly. You’ll need to be nimble to make the stairs up to the mezzanine bedroom. Half bottle of wine in the room was a nice touch.
Wished we stayed longer! This place was so comfortable and clean, and a great quiet location close to the action.
Amazing place! Super clean space and a good location. Walkable from lots of the shops and beach

The apartment was smaller than we thought, but it had everything we need. It is very clean, beautiful and well equipped. Unfortunately, at the time of our stay there was a construction site on the street in front of the apartment, which made it a bit noisy. We still had a nice stay there.

We had a great time staying at this apartment in Cedofeita. It's a perfect location for exploring Porto on foot. We also appreciated the little guidebook in the apartment which included some suggestions on landmarks and restaurants to visit. Some of the restaurant recommendations are less touristy than others which was nice, you can use online reviews to find more information too. The only downside to staying here was on our last day, our key card stopped working to open the main door. We were stuck outside in the rain at 8am with all our bags inside and had a train we needed to catch in 30 mins. Thankfully we were able to call Marisa and she gave us instructions to get a separate key from a lockbox to get back inside. Being given this lockbox information during check-in or being warned the key card may not open the door would've made the stay 5/5.
small room but perfect for solotravelers, got help/answers quickly and felt really comfortable! extremely cheap for the place and kindness of the host.
The flat was suitable for a short stay.,comfortable and clean .Very attentive for check in and any problems.

The apartment has great location with everything you need very close by. However the description and the reality is different. This is marketed as 1bdr apartment in the ad, so this is not true. The apartment in fact is a studio with the wall separating the bed from the rest of the apartment. So this is very small studio. The king bed almost touches the wall. No space to put the luggage. The sofa doesn't unfold so its not possible to sleep and again its very small and hard. The truth is that this studio is only for 2 people MAX. The cleanness of the apartment could be much better. The sink in the bath got clogged right after the first use. So i don't recommend. There are much better options.

Miguel has been a great host, very flexible with check-in and check-out timings. He's been helpful giving us a map and some tips about interesting spots and restaurants. The house is very comfortable and furnished with everything a guest may need. The view of the river is amazing. I surely recommend Miguel's apartment. We had a great stay

A very nice apartment in an ideal location for a stay in Porto. The apartment is very spacious (larger than it appears in the photos) and cozy, with a lovely interior. Everything is well equipped and very clean. Gi is a great host and would stay here again anytime.
Great place to stay in Porto, there are everything you need in this appartement and it was a very great location close to the center ! Would recommend it
This Airbnb is in a great location, has great decor, very easy to check in and out of, and loved the water and snacks left for us when we got there. Would 100% recommend!
Exactly as listed. Perfect location, very well organised, good communication. Would return and certainly recommend.

Pedro’s place is very cute and cozy. Nice sunny balcony for a coffee with side views to the river and access through a typical ribeira back street where time seems to have stoped. The flat had everything needed for a few days (at least for me) and it was well cleaned. Being in ribeira area, it’s very close to the river side but it is an uphill walk to the city centre, a nice one if you don’t mind walking. There are restaurants, bars and shops around. Only critic is that some details need attention as things get worn out! Overall 👌

Great place. D&S Smart Housing, the company that hosts this property, is right next door. We got there early and they were happy to hold our luggage for the day. They were also very helpful in guiding us around the city. We had a fantastic stay
The host was very helpful and responsive when necessary. The place was easy to find and very easily walkable to the center of the city. The house matched the description and was worth the price.

It was all very good at this place. The only problems were that the bathroom smelled very strongly of humidity and that when you showered, too much water would spill out of the shower floor, wetting the bathroom floor. All the rest was impeccable.

The place was wonderful! We were greeted very nicely and given a nice tour of the apartment as well as suggestions for main sites to visit. The place was very nicely decorated (loved the tiling in the kitchen) with a very spacious patio! We were also given a nice bottle of red wine at our arrival. I would definitely recommend staying at this place! Location was great, and the walk into Porto (river side) was only around 30 minutes. Definitely want to come back to Helena's air bnb!!!

We stayed in Marisa’s apartment for 4 nights. It is an excellent t apartment and the location is very good. We walked to all the the attractions during our stay. Marisa is an excellent host who was very responsive to our questions. She was personally present for the checkin and explained everything to us and often checked with us during our stay. The apartment is well equipped and neatly arranged. Recommended as a very good option for visitors to Porto.
Sara was very kind and we could reach her whenever it was needed. The place is Amazing. Thanks you again.

Angelo and his family are super nice people and very welcoming. The apartment is super clean and more spacious than it looks like on the picture. We had a great time at their house! It's a 15minutes ride to porto with the car (I would recommend to rent a car or use Uber). The apartment is only few meters from the sea away, which is really nice too. I totally recommend a stay at Angelo's flat!

We were in Porto for a few days and the small apartment was exactly what we needed to be able to process all the impressions of the day in the evening - lovingly renovated small apartment under the roof, quiet to sleep with enough space to drink coffee in the morning. Many thanks for the reliable communication and the large umbrella!

We really enjoyed our short stay. Arthur gave us a lot of great tips for our visit to Porto. The apartment is really nice, clean and well located, everything is in walking distance. Thanks for the uncomplicated stay in Porto! Julia & Raphael
Good location, central and close to the metro, convenient to join the very center in 10-15 mins. The appartment is clean and pleasant. I recommend this place!

We had a great time here. The views from the balcony are unreal! So nice! The apartment was clean and had everything you could need while you stay. The location is walkable to everything. Goran the host was so nice and warm and welcoming. He gave us a map of the city where he hand wrote us notes on places we should go and see and all his recommendations were amazing. Everything was smooth and easy :)
Great apartment. Very clean. Great location. Great mix of restaurants and prices. Close to airport metro station with left luggage facilities. We had a wonderful time.
Fabio´s flat was very clean and very good located. It was a good choice. The only disadvantage was a noise in the building (doors, elevator) and from outside.

From the time we booked, our host was super responsive and provided us with detailed information on checkin, nearby and in house amenities. And also local recommendations. Joao couldnt be there to welcome us but sent his daughter to greet us as we arrived and she was very sweet. She walked us through the home which was very cozy, spacious and well equipped. We were comfortable throughout our stay and would highly recommend this place if you want to stay some place that is away from the crowds but still walkable within 5 minutes. You can cook here if you like. The place is also near the popular Bolhao market. The neighbourhood is very safe and we felt at ease.
The apartment looks like in the pictures. The host was helpful and kind. The apartment's location so great. 👌
Wonderful unit and great location. Could not ask for any better. Excellent communication with host. Bus stop to airport just outside the building. Loved our stay.
We loved this apartment. It’s such a great space and the location is excellent. Everything is very accessible but you are away from the crowds.

Great apartment - spacious, well-designed and located in a quiet, pleasant neighborhood about a 20-minute walk from all the key spots in the city. Even though there’s no AC, it stayed comfortable inside thanks to the fans and dehumidifier. Having two bathrooms was also super convenient. Would definitely recommend!

Luisa is a very friendly host. Although she wasn’t around during our three-day stay, she was always available online to help whenever needed. Her home is extremely clean, and it truly gives you a sense of peace and comfort. I would definitely recommend staying here.

The apartment was spacious & with enough rooms to fit 8 persons. It was clean and located about 20 minutes walk to the historic area. I believe that if the kitchen & living room areas are updated, it will be a very nice place to stay. Bedrooms & beds were very comfortable.

Location is excellent, flat is small but has everything you need. There are two shops/cafes right next to the flat. Only criticism or perhaps even suggestion I would offer, is to have complimentary bottled water for guests on arrival. We arrived after 2am after travelling for almost 10 hours, a glass of cool water on arrival is something that would make a world of difference to your guests.

Fresh, new, stylish, spacious, comfortable and clean. Liked it a lot. Bed and couch very comfortable. Fine kitchen that allows for easy cooking. Host was very responsive and friendly. Highly recommended!

Maria’s apartment was clean tidy and spacious. It was in an ideal central part of the city with easy excess to the main train station and other big attractions in the city. Maria was an excellent host and was there to offer help and advice if needed.Definitely worth consideration. Winston Peden. Northern Ireland.

We would highly recommend this accommodation. It was spacious for a family of 5 with 2 adult children. It was immaculate, stylish with everything we needed available. We loved the location with cafes, bakeries and a great bar nearby. Carla was there if we needed her and provided us with plenty of information about Porto. We would definitely stay here again.

Thank you so much Pedro! He was the best host we’ve ever met ! He sent me loads of recommendations and links and he was always so quick to respond to me. His place is honestly much better and more spacious than it looks in the photos. We will 100% come back and stay at his airbnb again <3

I stayed for two weeks and it's a good value for the money. It's great for shorter stays - anyone with space issues might have an issue with the size of the common area with the kitchen, dining and bed being in the larger room - as I'd classify it as a New York efficiency with with a bathroom. Speaking of the bathroom, large shower stall and rain style shower head and for me at 6'2, was key. Hot water fast in the mornings. Kitchen had everything I needed from a prep perspective. A little patio as well.

My recent stay at Lovely’s place was simply delightful! From the moment I stepped through the door, I was greeted with a sense of warmth and cleanliness that immediately put me at ease. The apartment was spotless, exactly as advertised, and even more charming in person. One of the highlights of my stay was the thoughtful gesture from the host—a lovely bottle of wine from the region, accompanied by candied nuts. It was such a nice touch and added to the overall experience of feeling welcomed. Location-wise, this Airbnb couldn't be more perfect. It's conveniently situated close to everything, from local attractions to great restaurants and shops, making it incredibly easy to explore the area without having to travel far.

I had one of my best Airbnb experiences in Fernanda's apartment. I stayed for almost two months and enjoyed the apartment itself and the neighborhood very much. It's a clean, modern and a very functional one-bedroom apartment with everything one needs for a long stay. The kitchen was fully equipped and the bathroom was supplied with everything needed for weeks to come. The neighborhood was very walkable with a variety of shops and restaurants. The bed was also very comfortable. Fernanda was always responsive and gave me a refund when I had to leave a little early due to a family emergency. I highly recommend this apartment.
Great place just a short walk to everything! The apartment had everything we needed including an elevator which was appreciated after hiking up that hill from Sao Bento! 🤣
Joao was a really good and flexible host. The apartment was really clean and in good conditions.

Would have loved to stay another night or 2 here. The view is fantastic, and the patio in the backyard is perfect for a drink overlooking the Douro river (or breakfast). Clean and the bed was very comfy. Air conditioning as well. A great location, especially if you want to tour the Port houses and riverfront. overall I was very happy with our stay here. 👍

Incredible value for money. The duplex is exactly as advertised, walking distance to many shops and amenities, with the bridge and other sites all within a worthwhile 20-25 minute walk. Perfect for a two person trip, absolutely no complaints from check in to check out!

The house is super, clean , new, with fresh flower on the table and batroom, is fully equiped for eat: they offer salt, oil, vineagre, tea, coffe, sugar, oven ecc..Is a real host, always present for any question. They tell you where to go for good dinner, breakfast , train, what visit. The beach at100m .Caterina and her family are really kind and polite.The house is really like the pictures..one of best ever.Many thanks. Our 2 children enjoi the private garden and their bedroom.It's 25 minut by train to Porto and we left the car in their parking , and spent one night in Porto. Train station is 400m from the hause.super
Lovely clean apartment, great location, easy check in and Mel was really helpful. Would recommend.

Maria’s place was amazing. 1 mile walk to the center with many restaurants, things to see, and beautiful viewpoints of the whole city. It’s very nice to have your own bathroom. The bed looks small on the pictures but I am tall and felt fine. Maria was very communicative and would 100% recommend for Porto!

My husband And I got there really late because we had forgotten our passports in algarve, and had to drive all day to go retrieve them! But Maria and her husband waited patiently for us! Their place is amazing!! Would choose that room over any hotel!!

The place was very nice.Everything was just as shown in the pictures. The only downside was the temperature inside. It was extremely hot, even hotter than outside, and there was only a fan, which didn’t really help much. There wasn't enough airflow, which could be uncomfortable, especially for someone sensitive to heat. Other than that, everything was great! And our host, Inês, was very kind and responsive :)
We would say the same as for the review of the other apartment we rented at the same time - fantastic

Loved our stay in Porto and this apartment was fabulous! 10/10 for location - very fun and lively area - however, the owners have ensured you can get a peaceful night’s rest thanks to the very awesome double x double glazed windows and blinds. The area is central and buzzing with activity - easy to get to anywhere you need to go with lots of lovely restaurants and bars in waking distance. The apartment is spacious, light, comfortable, has good remote working space, a comfortable decent-sized bed, a great bathroom and all the amenities you need. There is a lift which is great for luggage. Our host,Sylvia was wonderful, responsive and accommodating and I highly recommend this apartment.

Great studio apartment in the heart or Porto, easily walkable to all the sites and areas. Lots of great local restaurants and the studio apartment was quiet, we heard no noise at night which was great. We would highly recommend staying here, it was great value.

The apartment is located in the central Porto. There are plenty of good restaurants and cafes around and most of attractions are within walking distance. There are plenty of buses to get around as well if the hills are too much for you. The interior is modern and clean. The shower is working great and all the amenities are working well including the washer and dryer. This particular unit is facing the back of the adjacent building so there isn’t much view but that makes the apartment very quiet. Overall the stay was very comfortable and I highly recommend the apartment.

The house has recently been remodeled and is in a tiny village close to the beach. Neighbors were friendly and check-in was easy. The village is very quiet and remote - good if you want to be by the beach, larger supermarkets about a 10 minute drive.
Amazing location. Apartment is simple and very spacious. It’s true what other reviews said about the smell- in the morning it was strong - but it was only a night, so no problem.

We stayed in Ricardo’s apartment for 4 nights, mid summer. We received very clear instructions regarding our arrival and the communication was very smooth. The apartment was very clean; I couldn’t find any dirty dishes or something familiar. The view from the apartment was great and the neighbors were very friendly. The apartment has a great view but is located on a very steep hill, therefore I won’t recommend it for elder people. All in all, we had a amazing holiday and we keep dreaming of the incredible view from the balcony!
We (family of 4) enjoyed two weeks at Maria's place. Everything was great and Maria was a fantastic host. We'll return!
Amazing location for your Porto stay. Easy communication and very helpful. The street is busy at night but you are right in the heart of the action. Spacious, clean and cool. Loved it

We stayed in Fien and Ricardos house for one week now in September 2022. The house is well equipped and great for a longer stay and has ideal conditions also with small kids. The beach, supermarket and a few paderias for a nice breakfast are all in walking distance. The neighborhood is quiet - we liked the typical 🐓-clucks in the backyards around.. their early morning wake up crowing give a typical and cosy countryside feeling so close to a big city. The father of Ricardo received us in time and was very helpful and polite. We can recommend the house 💯% with absolutely nothing to complain about.

Daniela’s place was as described. I enjoyed the privacy and eventhough the place is quite small, it could very well fit 4 people and meet all their needs. Daniela was very responsive and made sure I found the place (was waiting for me on the outside). Probably the best part was that the place is immediately on the beach and I have seen probably the best sunset in my life :)
